claim_first: Deduplicate/exclude delivered IDs; casefold tokenization as v1 with terminal plural s removed except ss/is. Rank by count of query terms in claim, then context, then title, then original discovery order. No novelty reward; no expected IDs. Stop when all three counts are zero.
same_page_ablation: Replay both selectors over each observed discovery page with identical delivered records/focus; grade IDs only after transcript completion. Shadow selections are not fetched and are not recovered support.
limitations: Known public development cases and guided intent, not held-out or autonomous quality.
Both caller policies use the same frozen focuses; novelty vs claim-first isolates selector effects within this policy.
Shadow samepage selections measure ranking preference only, not fetched evidence.
Conditional assertions require manual answer review; absence of a fact from a negative case is not a gate.
Help/CALLER prose edited before freeze; matching experiment starts after freeze.
